context: Lae'zel, a githyanki, is locked in a cage after tieflings shot her down intending to bind her and take her to the grove. The player has already attacked her, so she is angry/hostile and not going to submit quietly. The tieflings have been dealt with one way or another, but Lae'zel must be freed from the cage before she can be recruited. Companions (notably Shadowheart) may have warned against trusting her, and the scene can fallback into interrupted dialog or immediate combat depending on prior choices.
